name: comet-profile-switcher
title: Comet Profile Switcher
description: Open any Comet browser profile from Raycast. Give each profile its own alias or hotkey.
author: alexnicolai

commands.name: switch-profile
commands.title: Switch Comet Profile
commands.subtitle: Comet
commands.description: Browse your Comet profiles and open one. Create a Quicklink for a profile to give it an alias or hotkey.

commands.name: open-profile
commands.title: Open Comet Profile
commands.subtitle: Comet
commands.description: Open a Comet profile by name, optionally with a URL. Used by Quicklinks for per-profile aliases and hotkeys.

commands.name: shortcuts
commands.title: Comet Profile Shortcuts
commands.subtitle: Comet
commands.description: See and manage the aliases, Quicklinks and hotkeys that open each Comet profile.

preferences.name: cometApp
preferences.title: Comet Application
preferences.description: The Comet app to launch. Change this only if Comet is not in /Applications.

preferences.name: userDataDir
preferences.title: Comet Data Directory
preferences.description: Where Comet keeps its profiles. Leave blank for the default location.

preferences.name: alwaysNewWindow
preferences.title: Windows
preferences.label: Always open a new window
preferences.description: By default Comet focuses an existing window for the profile if one is open. Enable this to open a fresh window every time.
